description: Source code for a minimal fetch helper library used in a frontend web application. Provides functions for making HTTP requests with standardized responses, including handling JSON and plain text responses, and resolving API base URLs from environment variables.

methods.name: joinUrl(baseWithTrailingSlash, pathNoLeadingSlash)
methods.description: Concatenates a base URL and a path, ensuring no duplicate slashes.

methods.name: normalizeEndpoint(url)
methods.description: Ensures a URL string has exactly one trailing slash.

methods.name: tryReadJson(resp)
methods.description: Tries to parse a fetch response as JSON, returns null on failure.

methods.name: tryReadText(resp)
methods.description: Tries to read a fetch response as text, returns an empty string on failure.

methods.name: toErrorMessage({ json, text, status })
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message from JSON error data or fallback text.

methods.name: getBackendBaseUrl()
methods.description: Retrieves backend URL from environment variables with normalization.

methods.name: apiFetchText(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative = false } = {})
methods.description: Fetches plain text from an API endpoint with a consistent response shape.

methods.name: apiFetchJson(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative = false } = {})
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from an API endpoint with a consistent response shape.

ctags.name: apiFetchJson
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiFetchJson(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative/
ctags.signature: (path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative = false } = {})

ctags.name: apiFetchText
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiFetchText(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative/
ctags.signature: (path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative = false } = {})
